detail.title: Sort out which part it is, or not spend long on naming?
detail.question: This section is for a reader who already splits into too many parts, and it ends by giving them seven questions for sorting: “When something specific comes up, that’s the time to sort out what it is.” The inner child guide now says ([“Which thoughts to talk to”](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/189761959/which-thoughts-to-talk-to)): “I wouldn’t spend long deciding what to call each part you meet.” And in [“Start With What Shows Up”](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/189761959/start-with-what-shows-up): “Before you decide where it’s coming from, ask it what it’s trying to stop, or what it wants.” Bring this paragraph in line with that, or is the sorting how you mean it in this guide?
